name: Marine Electricals (India) Ltd
tagline: Integrated electrical & automation provider to naval/commercial shipbuilding, data centres and industry - a real, order-book-backed inflection riding two live tailwinds, but already priced at ~75x earnings
business_overview: Marine Electricals (India) Ltd (NSE: MARINE), established 1978, is an integrated provider of electrical automation, power electronics and ICT solutions. End-markets: Indian Navy & Coast Guard, commercial shipbuilding yards, ports, data centres (power distribution + building management systems), EV charging, and general industry. Promoter holding ~68%.
business_overview_note: Sovrenn-news seed (tier 4.65): 2026-06-17 orders of Rs 76.4 Cr from STT Global Data Centres India and Deepak Chem Tech for power distribution systems (12-18 month execution).
fundamentals_table: Revenue ~Rs 234 Cr (+59% YoY); PAT ~Rs 16.7 Cr (+53% YoY)
Rs 525 Cr (Mar-25) -> Rs 1,254 Cr (Mar-26); FY27 order inflow ~Rs 1,100 Cr in the first 4 months (Siemens, Titagarh, Princeton, STT Global DC, others)
fundamentals_narrative: The inflection is concrete and largely verifiable from disclosures: the order book more than doubled year-on-year to Rs 1,254 Cr (Mar-2026, ~1.4x FY26 revenue) and FY27 order inflow was already ~Rs 1,100 Cr within four months, from a spread of credible customers (Siemens, Titagarh, Princeton Group, STT Global Data Centres, Deepak Chem Tech). Q1FY27 standalone revenue grew ~59% YoY. That order-book-to-revenue coverage supports a multi-year growth runway if execution holds. The offsets: the stock has already re-rated ~144% in a year to ~75-80x earnings, 3-year ROE is only ~12%, and it is a project/systems-integration business where margins and working capital can be lumpy. No trusted-roster user has engaged.
technical_read: Not pulled (WebSearch only). The stock is up ~144% over one year - the re-rate is largely done, so entry timing matters.
sentiment_summary: First-time read of the full ValuePickr thread (marine-electricals-riding-the-waves-of-expansion, topic 199411, 8 posts, Jun-2025 to Jul-2026). Abhijay's opener (Jun-2025) framed the four legs - marine defence, data centres, EV charging, shipping - at a then-market-cap of ~Rs 2,885 Cr and P/E ~76x. anupammahor (Jun-Jul 2026, most active) tracked the order-book build in detail: Rs 525 Cr -> Rs 1,254 Cr book, ~Rs 1,100 Cr of FY27 inflows in four months including a Rs 375 Cr batch (Siemens/Titagarh/Princeton) and a further Rs 141 Cr from Princeton. Thread is small and mostly order-flow tracking; no bear case articulated beyond the implicit valuation concern.
community_signal: No trusted-roster user has posted. Non-trusted engagement (anupammahor) is factual order-book tracking, consistently positive on inflow momentum. Community conviction is thin - the thread is only 8 posts.
bse_notes: Post-FY26-results press release detailing order book Rs 1,254 Cr; subsequent order announcements through FY27 Q1 (STT Global Data Centres + Deepak Chem Tech Rs 76.4 Cr on 2026-06-17; Siemens/Titagarh/Princeton Rs 375 Cr on 2026-07-26; Princeton Rs 141 Cr on 2026-07-28).

value_chain.theme: Data-centre power & cooling (power distribution / BMS) + shipbuilding & maritime electricals
value_chain.position: Systems integrator - designs and supplies power distribution boards, automation and BMS packages into DC builds, and integrated electrical/automation packages into naval and commercial shipbuilding
value_chain.bottleneck_node: Qualified electrical-package vendors for hyperscale DC and for defence/commercial shipyards - a limited approved-vendor pool
value_chain.note: Sits on two live tailwinds at once: DC power distribution (priority-1 theme - India DC buildout) and shipbuilding & maritime (priority-2 - naval order visibility + commercial-shipbuilding cluster push). Order book is the evidence the exposure is real, not narrative. Risk is that as a mid-tier integrator it competes for share against much larger electrical majors on the biggest packages.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: FY26 revenue +14% YoY full-year; Q4FY26 revenue +10.7%; Q1FY27 standalone revenue +59% YoY, PAT +53% - a clear step-up as the order book converts
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~75-80x trailing needs ~40%+ sustained EPS CAGR even at a generous ~30x exit; the order book (book-to-bill >1.4x, ~Rs 1,100 Cr FY27 inflow in 4 months) supports high growth near-term but the multiple leaves little room for execution slips

bull_case: Order book more than doubled YoY to Rs 1,254 Cr and FY27 inflows ~Rs 1,100 Cr in four months - a concrete, disclosure-backed growth runway, not just a story
Dual exposure to two live tailwinds: data-centre power distribution (priority-1 theme) and naval/commercial shipbuilding electricals (priority-2)
Q1FY27 already shows the step-up (revenue +59%, PAT +53% YoY); ~68% promoter holding; ROCE ~16%
Credible marquee customers (Siemens, Titagarh, STT Global Data Centres)
bear_case: Valuation already ~75-80x earnings after a ~144% one-year re-rate - most of the near-term growth looks priced in
3-year ROE only ~12%; project/integration business with lumpy margins and working-capital swings
Thin ValuePickr thread (8 posts), zero trusted-roster engagement - low community-conviction base
Competes for the largest DC and shipyard packages against much bigger electrical majors (ABB, Siemens, CG Power)
verdict_headline: Genuine order-book-backed inflection on two live tailwinds - scored 10x-in-2-3-years at Medium, but 'unconfirmed' given a ~75x multiple and no trusted validation
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn-news seed (tier 4.65). The Sovrenn datapoint (Rs 76.4 Cr STT Global DC + Deepak Chem Tech order) holds up and is one of several - the FY27 order inflow is ~Rs 1,100 Cr in four months against ~Rs 877 Cr FY26 revenue, so the acceleration is real and verifiable from filings

Per the trailing-average-vs-live-inflection rule: weak-ish trailing (3yr ROE ~12%) but a strong specific recent quarter (Q1FY27 revenue +59%, PAT +53%) plus a concrete catalyst (order-book conversion over 12-18 months) and dual live-theme exposure (DC power distribution priority-1; shipbuilding priority-2) -> 10x-in-2-3-years at Medium with an explicit 'unconfirmed' caveat, not neither

Conviction capped at Medium (not higher) by the ~75-80x valuation after a ~144% one-year run and the absence of any trusted-roster engagement on the thin thread. revisit_after_30d true - watch Q2FY27 execution/margins and further order inflow

four_box.note: Dual data-centre-power + naval/shipbuilding-electricals tailwind is real and order-book-evidenced (Rs1,254cr, >1.4x FY26 revenue); approved-vendor-pool moat is real but company competes against much larger majors (ABB/Siemens/CG Power) for biggest packages — weak; ~75-80x P/E after a 144% 1-yr re-rate already prices most near-term growth — valuation no.
